name: Proposition
description: A statement that is either true or false; the truth-bearer over which L6-PROOF reasons and which axioms assert.

metadata.note: Layer-0 bedrock for the prover; axioms ARE distinguished propositions

name: Set
description: A collection of distinct elements; the underlying carrier on which all algebraic structures are built.

metadata.note: Layer-1 carrier; every structure = a set + operations + axioms

name: Natural number
description: Inductive type generated by zero and successor (Peano); supplies indices, cardinalities, and vector/space dimensions.

metadata.note: Layer-1 inductive primitive; N in R^N, indices, dimensions

name: Field (type)
description: A set equipped with addition and multiplication satisfying the field axioms (commutative ring with multiplicative inverses for nonzero elements).

metadata.note: Layer-2 ground; complex_field + real_field SPECIALIZE this (Testbed 46b)

name: Group (type)
description: A set with an associative binary operation, identity, and inverses; underlies the unit-modulus phasor group and additive groups.

metadata.note: Layer-2 ground; unit-circle phasors form a group; vector_space additive group SPECIALIZES this

name: Category (type)
description: Objects with morphisms closed under associative composition with identities; the substrate's operators are morphisms in a category.

name: Functor (type)
description: A structure-preserving map between categories (maps objects and morphisms, preserving composition and identity); e.g. List, Free-Vector, Powerset.

metadata.note: Layer-1; structure-preserving map; composes with category_type

name: Pair / dependent-pair (Sigma) type
description: Product / dependent-pair (Sigma) type pairing two values; grounds labeled examples and bilinear (two-argument) operation domains.

metadata.note: Layer-1; (A x B) / Sigma(a:A).B(a); bilinear + supervised-pair domains
